from tax.calculator import compute_sales_tax


def test_half_cent_tie_rounds_to_even():
    # 2.50 * 5% = 0.125, a half-cent tie: banker's rounding -> 0.12 (even), not 0.13
    assert compute_sales_tax("2.50", "5.0") == "0.12"
explanation: Chooses inputs whose tax lands exactly on a half-cent tie (0.125) and asserts half-to-even rounds down to the even cent 0.12. No existing test lands on a tie, which is why switching to half-up rounding survived.
rationale: Asserting 0.125 rounds to 0.12 distinguishes banker's rounding from half-up and detects the semantic change.
